title_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Super Penthouse Me Verande Dhe Pamje Te Mrekullueshme !!
description_sq: Tek Liqeni i Thate, ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara ne Tirane, shitet Super Penthouse me punime super cilesore. Penthouse ndodhet ne katin e 6 teknik dhe eshte i organizuar ne nje sallon me hapesire te madhe, i cili ka dalje ne verande, kurse ambienti i gatimit eshte ne nje hapesire me vete, qe gjithashtu ka dalje ne verande, gjithashtu ka dhe nje ambient me vete me oxhak, 3 dhoma gjumi ku njera prej tyre eshte e pajisur me tualet personal (me dritare), 1 tualet qendror (me dritare), ballkon dhe verande qe te ofron nje pamje te mrekullueshme nga liqeni artificial dhe kodrat e liqenit. Ne te gjithe hapesiren e brendshme eshte vendosur sistemi i ngrohjes qendrore (me kaldaje). Zona eshte ideale per dike qe kerkon nje jetese te qete ne ajer te paster dhe larg zhurmave, por dhe per investim per tu ndare ne 2-3 apartamente, pasi qirate jane shume te shtrenjta ne zone.
title_en: At Lake Dry, Super Penthouse For Sale With Verandah And Wonderful View!!
description_en: At Liqeni i Thate, in one of the most sought-after areas in Tirana, a Super Penthouse with super quality works is for sale. The penthouse is located on the 6th technical floor and is organized in a large living room, which has access to the veranda, while the kitchen area is in a separate space, which also has an exit to the veranda, it also has a separate area with a fireplace, 3 bedrooms, one of which is equipped with a personal toilet (with window), 1 central toilet (with window), a balcony and a veranda that offers a wonderful view of the artificial lake and the hills of the lake. A central heating system (with boiler) has been installed throughout the interior space. The area is ideal for someone looking for a quiet life in clean air and away from noise, but also for investment to divide into 2-3 apartments, as rents are very expensive in the area.
